intro.text: Numbers turn up everywhere: dates, times, prices and addresses. Let’s practise them inside real sentences.
intro.tip: Say each number in your head as you type it – it helps your fingers stay in order.

steps.title: Real-world numbers
text: Meet me at 10 Station Road at 2:30. The train costs 15 pounds and takes 45 minutes.
On 4 June 2026, 120 children ran 5 kilometres for charity. They raised 2500 pounds!
